title: publisher-crates plugin configuration
description: Schema v1 for the publisher-crates semrel plugin. Configure via SEMREL_* environment variables.

SEMREL_PLUGIN_CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN.description: crates.io registry token used to publish the crate. Falls back to CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN.

SEMREL_PLUGIN_CARGO_WORKSPACE_MEMBER.description: Comma-separated list of workspace members to publish.

SEMREL_PLUGIN_CARGO_PACKAGE.description: Comma-separated list of packages to publish (alias for SEMREL_PLUGIN_CARGO_WORKSPACE_MEMBER).

SEMREL_VERSION.description: Release version for the current semrel execution.

SEMREL_NEXT_VERSION.description: Calculated next release version when SEMREL_VERSION is not yet finalized.

SEMREL_DRY_RUN.description: When true, perform validation and logging only without executing side effects.
